config.text:
name = "uav-operator-day8-qwen35-2b-t1-smoke-25"
model = "Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B"
loss = "rl"
max_steps = 25

batch_size = 16
rollouts_per_example = 2
max_inflight_rollouts = 4
learning_rate = 3e-5
lora_alpha = 32

[sampling]
max_tokens = 1024
temperature = 0.7
enable_thinking = false

[[env]]
id = "jarrett/uav-operator@0.1.1"
args = { tier = "T1", dataset_split = "train", max_examples = 75, max_turns = 20 }

[eval]
interval = 5
num_examples = 15
rollouts_per_example = 2
skip_first_step = false

[[eval.env]]
id = "jarrett/uav-operator@0.1.1"
args = { tier = "T1", dataset_split = "dev", max_examples = 15, max_turns = 20 }

[eval.sampling]
max_tokens = 1024
temperature = 0.0
enable_thinking = false

[checkpoints]
interval = 5
keep_cloud = 2

[adapters]
interval = 5
keep_last = 3

content_policy: No model prompt, response, completion, or natural-language judgment is stored; reward evidence comes only from platform metrics computed by the environment.
